newsitem.title: MEXICO: Tropical storm Andres hovers off Mexican coast.
newsitem.headline: Tropical storm Andres hovers off Mexican coast.

text.p: Tropical storm Andres, dumping heavy rain over southern Mexico, is hovering off the coast of the state of Chiapas and seen losing steam in the next few hours, the National Weather Service said Thursday.

At dawn, Andres' eye was 34 miles (55 km) south of Tapachula, a city in southern Chiapas on the border with Guatemala. The storm was packing winds of 41 mph (65 km/h) and gusts of 47 mph (75 km/h), the service said.

"It is expected that tropical storm Andres moves easterly, which will take the center of the storm over land later today, weakening to a tropical depression," the service said. Andres is likely to touch land in Guatemala, it added.
Rains of up to three inches (7 cm) are expected in Chiapas, traditionally Mexico's top coffee producing state and also a leading sugar and corn zone, the service said.
Shipping warnings were still in place along the Gulf of Tehuantepec from Puerto Arista in Chiapas to Guatemala.
